_comment: Curated, not live — see docs/research/12-ferry-dive-site-data-sourcing.md. No API/feed exists for Belize water-taxi schedules anywhere (government or private); this is manually transcribed from each operator's own published schedule and needs re-checking every 2-3 months or after any hurricane-season disruption (Jun-Nov). Always update lastVerifiedAt when you touch a route.

routes.name: Belize City ↔ Caye Caulker ↔ San Pedro
routes.notes: The two operators run overlapping but not identical schedules — check both. Confirmed live drift between Caribbean Sprinter's own published times and any cached/third-party copy (including OpenStreetMap's), so treat any time below as approximate.

routes.name: San Pedro ↔ Chetumal, Mexico (international)
routes.notes: International leg — passengers must clear Belize immigration at San Pedro's Point of Entry, confirmed open only 8:00 AM–5:00 PM daily. No boat can legally arrive or depart outside that window, regardless of what an operator's own posted time says. Runs roughly every other day rather than daily per multiple independent reports — confirm directly before planning around a specific date.

routes.name: Corozal ↔ San Pedro

operators.name: Thunderbolt Travels
operators.contactNote: No standalone website found — reservations run through WhatsApp/Facebook only. The least formal of the operators in this list; hardest to keep current.

routes.notes: Also serves Sarteneja along the way. Confirm departure directly via WhatsApp — no published schedule exists to transcribe from.

routes.name: Placencia ↔ Independence/Mango Creek

operators.contactNote: Schedule hosted on a free Google Sites page last touched in 2016 — about as fragile a source as exists. Treat any time on it as unconfirmed until cross-checked.
